title: L1A Question Bank
description: One module's questions: content/<tier>/questions/<NN>-<slug>.json, e.g. content/emt/questions/02-airway.json. Kept out of the module file because at ~8 questions per concept a module's bank dwarfs its content, and reading one lesson should not mean downloading every question in the module. Loaded on demand when a test starts. Questions whose id does not begin with this file's module_id do not belong here.

module_id.description: Module this bank belongs to: TIER-MM. Every question id here starts with it.

tier.description: Matches the content/ subfolder name and the module file's tier.

questions.description: The items, inline. Order is irrelevant - the test engine selects by concept, domain, style and difficulty. Retired items stay in the array and are filtered at selection time.
